notes.title: Soaring Reviews Of Skye Tales
notes.content:
Since the release on Nintendo Switch in May 2023 Skye Tales has been a tranquil and stress-free gaming getaway for players young and old. But don't just take our word for it have a look at these reviews and discover why Skye Tales is the perfect antidote for a busy life.

"Skye Tales is a beautifully crafted and carefully thought-out game. There is a wide-ranging selection of puzzles with varying degrees of difficulty. There is much to delight the casual gamer!". - [url=https://ladiesgamers.com/skye-tales-review/]LadiesGamers[/url]

[b]8.5/10[/b] "Skye Tales is a charming and playful puzzle game that I honestly couldn’t put down once I started. The pure joy of flying through the world and playing with all the interactive elements is infectious, and the puzzles, while simple, are a lot of fun to solve." -[url=https://www.godisageek.com/reviews/skye-tales-review/]God Is A Geek[/url]

[b]18/20[/b] "With its beautiful graphics, soothing soundtrack and intuitive gameplay mechanics, it offers an immersive and captivating experience. Whether you're looking to relax, solve puzzles or explore a world full of surprises, Skye Tales will captivate you." - [url=https://essentielactu.com/skye-tales-monde-enchanteur-detendez-vous-test-complet-nintendo-switch]Essential Actu[/url]

Skye Tales is releasing on Steam, the Epic Game Store, and the PlayStation Store on August 17th.

notes.title: Cozy puzzle game Skye Tales coming to Steam on August 17th
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Skye Tales is coming to PlayStation, Steam and the Epic Games Store on August 17th.

[previewyoutube=mtp22QR4tXw;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Glide across the colorful, musical, cozy valleys of Brinn in Skye Tales, a gentle puzzle exploration game set in a world that couldn’t be happier to see you!

Get ready to experience the stunning visuals and relaxing gameplay by wishlisting Skye Tales on Steam.
